title: Asuka-FM: A System-Architectural Co-Design Framework for Efficient Text-to-Image Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
abstract: arXiv:2611.26437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier text-to-image (T2I) foundation models predominantly rely on multi-billion parameter Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pretrained across massive compute clusters, creating an accessibility barrier for academic laboratories. When training DiTs from scratch on single consumer GPUs (e.g., an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24\,GB VRAM), practitioners encounter three primary bottlenecks: quadratic attention sequence costs, Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation graph breaks induced by variable aspect-ratio bucketing, and an autoencoder throughput wall where frozen Variational Autoencoder (VAE) operations dominate step latency. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Asuka-FM}, an end-to-end system and architectural framework demonstrating that competitive dual-stream DiTs ($\sim$206M parameters) can be pretrained from scratch on a single consumer GPU in $\sim$160 GPU hours for under \$55. translated_abstract: 前沿的文本到图像（T2I）基础模型主要依赖数十亿参数的扩散Transformer（DiT），并在大规模计算集群上进行预训练，这为学术实验室设置了可及性障碍。当在单个消费级GPU（例如配备24GB显存的NVIDIA RTX 4090）上从头训练DiT时，实践者会遇到三个主要瓶颈：二次方复杂度注意力的序列开销、由可变长宽比分桶引发的即时编译（JIT）图中断，以及自动编码器的吞吐量瓶颈——即被冻结的变分自动编码器（VAE）操作主导了每步延迟。在本工作中，我们提出了Asuka-FM，一个端到端的系统与架构框架，证明了具有竞争力的双流DiT（约2.06亿参数）可以在单个消费级GPU上从头完成预训练，仅需约160 GPU小时，成本低于55美元。Asuka-FM集成了四项核心设计：(i) 无AdaLN的双流Di……
tldr: 该论文提出系统-架构协同设计框架Asuka-FM，证明约2.06亿参数的双流扩散Transformer可在单张消费级GPU上以约160 GPU小时、不足55美元的成本从头完成有竞争力的文本到图像模型预训练，并解决了注意力开销、JIT图中断和VAE吞吐量三大瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Asuka-FM, a system-architectural co-design framework demonstrating that competitive ~206M-parameter dual-stream DiTs can be pretrained from scratch on a single consumer GPU in ~160 GPU hours for under $55, while addressing quadratic attention costs, JIT graph breaks, and VAE throughput bottlenecks.
